issues.problem: The one sorry under Lemma 2.14 and Cor 2.15 sits on an abstract statement: any causality C with SingularFlatAxioms, x <= y <= x in sing 0 implies x = y. The declaration's own docstring and SORRY text say that at this generality it 'may be UNPROVABLE', because SFA carries neither E0 charts nor Prop 1.3's tube, and that 'the chart-based form for E0-manifolds (C = CE M, sing = chartedSing e0SingY M) is the one owed'. That form is still not stated. A tagged sorry should mark a true statement blocked by a missing construction, not a statement its author suspects may be false: if it is false, btzExt_isCausal_of_stronglyCausalOn and cor_GH_causal are false sorried theorems, and no E0 version of Lemma 2.14 / Cor 2.15 exists to fall back on. The fix costs nothing now. WP-43c made SFA unconditional for E0-manifolds (e0_sfa_of_globalBTZ) and used exactly that to give Lemma 2.13 its _e0 forms, but did not do the same for 2.14/2.15. The dispatch asked for this lemma by the chart route (finite chart cover + Prop 1.3), which only makes sense in the E0 form.
issues.fix: Move the sorry to an E0 statement and leave the abstract layer sorry-free. (i) Add sing_eq_of_le_of_le_of_stronglyCausalOn_e0 for an E0-manifold M: C = CE M, sing = chartedSing e0SingY M, A open with A-complement in S0 M, StronglyCausalOn (CE M) A. Put the tagged SORRY(Lemma 2.14) on it, with the tube obstruction. (ii) Give btzExt_isCausal_of_stronglyCausalOn and cor_GH_causal the loop exclusion as an explicit named hypothesis, so they become sorry-free (the regular case is already proved). (iii) Derive btzExt_isCausal_of_stronglyCausalOn_e0 and cor_GH_causal_e0 from (i). (iv) Delete the abstract sorried lemma, or keep it as an explicitly open generalisation that nothing depends on. Then update the REPORT rows' decls and sorries.
